hooks.command: npm test > /tmp/test-log-run.txt 2>&1; ec=$?; echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) $( [ $ec -eq 0 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL )" >> .claude/test-log.txt

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */server/*) rel=${f#$PWD/}; out=$(claude -p --agent tracker-reviewer "Review $rel" 2>&1); printf '=== %s %s ===
%s

' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rel" "$out" >> .claude/review-log.txt ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
